items.title: [GeoNode] GeoNode has Stored XSS in Documents metadata abstract field
items.summary: The abstract metadata of documents is not sanitised. It’s possible to store arbitrary HTML (and JS) that will be executed when visiting the page.Referenceshttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/security/advisories/GHSA-r4hm-p9f9-fj9vhttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/pull/14322https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/pull/14343https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/commit/0803857b22eba5b55729145ef401b1bc1c23e332https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/commit/730d8fae206ea5b051f630718aeecae1bf7b5760https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/releases/tag/5.0.3https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r4hm-p9f9-fj9v

items.title: [GeoNode] GeoNode has Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: The upload service validation can be circumvented with specially crafted requests, allowing for the storage and serving of malicious files.Referenceshttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/security/advisories/GHSA-fqpv-mq26-pr4jhttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/pull/14223https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/pull/14224https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/commit/16ec8b3914fe87d0a258c14cf73b0a4295bb072fhttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/commit/239a6b49c925957197033831df5f20c4c13a14dahttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/releases/tag/5.0.3https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fqpv-mq26-pr4j

items.title: [GeoNode] GeoNode has OS command injection via uploaded file layer name
items.summary: Arbitrary OS commands can be executed on the GeoNode by uploading a vector file with a crafted layer name.Referenceshttps://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/security/advisories/GHSA-9fpx-fr6j-2vh6https://github.com/GeoNode/geonode/commit/1408290c0bb54872924a9b334a516db9758a2180https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9fpx-fr6j-2vh6
